transaction_types.name: Book a discovery call
transaction_types.description: Book a free 30-minute video call with a consultant.
transaction_types.consequences: Creates a calendar booking and sends a confirmation email to the attendee. No payment is taken.
transaction_types.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 2 hours before the call.

transaction_types.name: Request an Executive AI Workshop
transaction_types.description: Reserve a workshop date for your leadership team.
transaction_types.consequences: Reserves the date and issues an invoice for a 50% deposit, payable within 14 days.
transaction_types.cancellation_policy: Deposit refundable up to 30 days before the workshop.
